This is nitro to amine transformation on aromatic ring. So applying this template to product (amine) should give nitro precursor. The mapped_rxn shows product and reactant. The product_smiles is the amine product (same as our product). The reactant_smiles is the nitro precursor. So the precursors are the nitro aromatic and the other partner? So the precursor list is just one SMILES: the nitro version. However earlier answer from apply_template-1 gave two precursors: the amine heterocycle and the sulfonyl chloride. That seems unrelated; maybe the target molecule is a larger structure containing both parts. The product SMILES we have is the amine heterocycle attached to something? This is a fused aromatic with amine substituent. The nitro precursor would be same but with NO2 instead of NH2. Thus the precursors list likely includes the nitro aromatic and maybe the other reagent (e.g., reducing agent). But the template likely only splits the product into nitro precursor (single). The task expects list of lists where each inner list contains SMILES of each precursor. For nitro reduction, the other precursor could be hydrogen (H2) or metal catalyst, but not included. Usually they include only the substrate (nitro) as precursor. So answer likely: [["O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)cc1"]]? But need to match exact SMILES of nitro version of our product.
